propwash.race.config.title: Race
propwash.race.config.laps.tooltip: Lap count for courses you create and for courses without their own lap count. Every course has its own lap count: Leaderboard → Edit course. Endless = free practice with lap times.
propwash.race.config.countdown.tooltip: Arming the drone near the start gate lines you up and the start lights count down. The “Restart race” key does the same at any time.
propwash.race.config.countdown_seconds.t: Length of the countdown before the start signal (at least 3 s with several pilots)
propwash.race.config.start_hint.tooltip: Gate 1 of every course pulses green while you are not racing
propwash.race.config.messages.tooltip: Countdown, lap times, splits and warnings in the middle of the screen
propwash.race.config.ghost.tooltip: A translucent blue drone flies your personal best lap on this course with your drone class. Splits show the gap to it.
propwash.race.config.report.tooltip: Lap times go into the course leaderboard (/propwash race leaderboard)
propwash.race.config.help: Fly through the start/finish gate (gate 1, black-and-white checkered) to start the clock, or press “Restart race” at the start for a standing start with start lights – other pilots at the start can line up too. The green gate is your next one. The arrows on the ground in front of each gate show the flight direction; a gate does not count from its back (red markings). A lap ends when you pass gate 1 again after all other gates.
propwash.race.tool.cleared: Course selection cleared – the next gate you click starts a new course
propwash.race.tool.not_owner: Course %s belongs to %s – only its creator or an operator may change it
propwash.race.tool.too_many: There are already %s courses – delete one first with /propwash race delete
propwash.race.gate.break_hint: Sneak or hold the course tool to break the gate
propwash.race.server.leaderboard_archive: Course %s was changed – the leaderboard of layout %s is archived, a new one begins
propwash.help.gate.what.1: A gate for race tracks. Your next gate
propwash.help.gate.use.1: Right-click floor, wall or ceiling to place;
propwash.help.gate.use.2: the preview shows mount and flight direction.
propwash.help.gate.use.4: holding a gate or the tool: placed gates too.
propwash.help.course_tool.summary: Links gates into a race course
propwash.help.course_tool.what.1: Sets the order in which the gates
propwash.help.course_tool.use.4: Racing: press Restart race at the start.
propwash.race.tool.tooltip.sneak_air_2: the next gate starts a new one
propwash.help.gate.use.5: Sneak + right-click a gate: adjust it.
propwash.race.server.class_record: %s sets a class record on course %s: %s (%s)
propwash.race.lobby.not_at_start: Fly to the start gate to line up
propwash.race.lobby.waiting: Starting grid course %s · %s pilots · start in %s s
propwash.race.lobby.open: Starting grid on course %s (%s pilots) · %s to join
propwash.race.msg.assist_start: This lap won't count for the leaderboard: %s
propwash.race.assist.hold_mode: altitude or position hold was on
propwash.race.assist.parts_mismatch: this drone only exists with "Parts must match" turned off
propwash.race.assist.goggles_latency: creative goggles show the picture faster than the video transmitter
propwash.race.assist.goggles_latency.ms: creative goggles at %s ms latency instead of the transmitter's %s ms
propwash.race.board.title: Leaderboard
propwash.race.board.empty: No lap time yet – fly the first one!
propwash.race.config.start_lights.toolti: Red lamps count down the start, all green means GO. Crossing the start gate early costs a 3 s penalty.
propwash.race.config.record_ghost.toolti: A golden drone flies the server record of your drone class on this course
propwash.race.config.leaderboard.tooltip: The ten best laps of the course with class and date. Also by right-clicking the air with the course tool.
propwash.race.tool.tooltip.air: Right-click the air: leaderboard, edit course
propwash.race.config.race_line.tooltip: Only during a started race: a glowing line leads through the next gates. It disappears at the finish or when the race is aborted, and never shows while flying freely or building.
propwash.race.config.race_line_gates.too: How many gates ahead the line reaches before it fades out
propwash.race.gate.stack_too_wide: A gate only fits on a gate that is at least as wide
propwash.race.gate.stack_too_high: At most %s gates on top of each other
propwash.help.gate.use.6: Right-click a standing gate: stack on top.
propwash.help.gate.use.7: Remove: left-click with tool or while sneaking.
propwash.race.gate.stack_standing_only: Only standing, untilted gates on the floor can be stacked
propwash.race.mount.too_far: Too far away to rotate the gate
propwash.race.mount.stack_locked: Stacked gates only turn by 180° and keep their mount
propwash.race.mount.blocked: Rotated, the gate would not fit here
propwash.help.gate.use.8: In flight, %s cycles the flight mode.
propwash.race.mount.need_tool: Hold a gate or the course tool to rotate this gate
propwash.race.tool.tooltip.rotate: Look at a gate + %s: rotate, sneak: change mount
propwash.race.edit.title: Adjust gate
propwash.race.edit.heading: Yaw
propwash.race.edit.heading.tooltip: Direction of the gate in degrees, like a compass. Drag, arrow keys (shift ×10) or −/+ in the rotation step; right-click: reset.
propwash.race.edit.pitch.tooltip: Tilts the gate. Positive: the flight direction points upwards and the top leans towards the entry side. ±90° lays a standing gate flat.
propwash.race.edit.roll.tooltip: Turns the gate within its plane, clockwise as seen by the pilot. 45° turns the square into a diamond.
propwash.race.edit.width.tooltip: Clear width of the opening in blocks, 1 to 16 in half steps. The frame is added on the outside.
propwash.race.edit.height.tooltip: Clear height of the opening in blocks, 1 to 16 in half steps. The frame is added on the outside.
propwash.race.edit.reset.tooltip: Tilt back to 0° and the opening back to the size of the gate item
propwash.race.edit.unlink.tooltip: Takes the gate out of its course, the remaining gates move up
propwash.race.edit.unlink.need_tool: Hold the course tool to do this
propwash.race.edit.status.same: No change yet. The preview appears as soon as you adjust something.
propwash.race.edit.status.blocked: Like this the gate would not fit here
propwash.race.edit.status.stacked: Stacked gates cannot be adjusted – take the stack apart first
propwash.race.edit.status.too_far: Too far away to apply – move closer
propwash.race.edit.closed.tool: Stopped adjusting the gate: no gate or course tool in hand
propwash.race.edit.closed.far: Stopped adjusting the gate: too far away
propwash.race.config.rotate_step.tooltip: How far %s turns a standing or hanging gate: 90° as before, 45°, 15° or 5° for angled gates. Flat and wall gates are still reversed by the key. To rotate freely, tilt and resize: sneak + right-click the gate.
propwash.race.element.heading: heading %s°
propwash.race.element.floor_only: Course elements only stand on the ground
propwash.race.element.no_stack: Nothing stacks on flags, poles and cubes
propwash.race.element.label: %s %s · Course %s · %s
propwash.race.element.edit.title: %s settings
propwash.race.edit.element.heading: Heading
propwash.race.edit.element.heading.toolt: Which way the element faces: the flight direction it is flown in, in degrees like a compass. Drag, arrow keys (shift ×10) or −/+ in the rotation step; right-click: reset.
Which side of the pole the drone has to pass, seen in flight direction. Click: other side.
Turn left around: the flag stays on your left while you fly around it. Click: other direction.
Which side the drone has to leave the cube through after diving in, seen from the cube's heading. Click: next side.
propwash.race.edit.element.pole.width.to: How far from the pole a pass still counts, in blocks. Further out it doesn't.
propwash.race.edit.element.pole.height.t: Height of the pole in blocks. Flying over the pole doesn't count as passing it.
propwash.race.edit.element.flag.width.to: How far around the flag the turn still counts, in blocks.
propwash.race.edit.element.flag.height.t: Height of the flag pole in blocks. Flying over the flag doesn't count.
propwash.race.edit.element.cube.width.to: Clear width of the openings in blocks, 1 to 16 in half steps. The poles add to the outside.
propwash.race.edit.element.cube.height.t: Clear height of the side openings in blocks. The poles add to the outside.
propwash.race.tool.start_gate: A %s can't be start and finish – click a gate or freeform gate first
propwash.race.msg.missed_element: Missed %s %s – go back and do it right!
propwash.race.msg.wrong_side.cube: Cube %s: dive in from the top, %s
propwash.help.race_flag.summary: Turn marker: left or right around
propwash.help.race_flag.what.1: Fly past the flag, around behind it
propwash.help.race_flag.what.2: and back on the other side.
propwash.help.slalom_pole.summary: Slalom pole: pass on the left or right
propwash.help.slalom_pole.what.1: Each pole only counts on its own side,
propwash.help.slalom_pole.what.2: the arrows on the ground show it.
propwash.race.pole.no_seat: Gate poles only sit on the top corners of upright gates or on top of a standing gate pole
propwash.race.pole.too_high: At most %s gate poles on top of each other
propwash.race.pole.not_in_course: Gate poles are obstacles and markers – they don't belong to a course
propwash.race.pole.hint_seated: Right-click: put it on · then sneak + right-click: adjust
propwash.race.pole.label: %s · %s · not part of a course
propwash.race.pole.locked: Take the gate poles on top off first
propwash.race.element.edit.variant.gate_: Color of the LED strips. With a dye in your hand you can also right-click the pole.
propwash.race.edit.element.gate_pole.hei: Length of the pole in blocks, in half-block steps like the sides of gates. Poles on top don't move along: take them off first.
propwash.help.gate_pole.summary: One side of a gate: obstacle and marker
propwash.help.gate_pole.what.1: Stands on the ground, sticks out of a wall or
propwash.help.gate_pole.what.2: hangs from the ceiling; not part of courses.
propwash.help.gate_pole.use.1: Right-click ground, wall or ceiling: place.
propwash.help.gate_pole.use.3: Right-click a gate: put it on the corner,
propwash.help.gate_pole.use.4: a pole: extend it (up to 4 on top).
propwash.help.gate_pole.use.6: Dye + right-click: color of the LEDs.
propwash.help.gate_pole.use.7: Break: course tool or sneak + left-click.
propwash.help.dive_cube.summary: Cube: dive in from the top, out a side
propwash.help.dive_cube.what.1: Dive into the cube from the top and fly
propwash.help.course_element.use.1: Right-click the ground: set it up.
propwash.help.course_element.use.3: Course tool: append it like a gate;
propwash.help.course_element.use.4: poles in a row alternate their side.
propwash.help.course_element.use.6: Remove: left-click with tool or while sneaking.
propwash.race.freeform.start_blocked: No opening here – click a block at the edge of a passage, cave mouth or window
propwash.race.freeform.open: The opening isn't closed all around – blocks have to enclose it within %s × %s blocks
propwash.race.freeform.too_big: The opening is %s × %s blocks – at most %s × %s are allowed (world rule)
propwash.race.freeform.unloaded: The opening reaches into chunks that aren't loaded
propwash.race.freeform.taken: There already is a freeform gate here
propwash.race.freeform.no_stack: Freeform gates form in openings made of blocks, not on gates
propwash.race.freeform.edit.title: Adjust freeform gate
propwash.race.freeform.edit.flip.tooltip: The gate then counts the other way round. The arrows in the opening show the flight direction.
propwash.race.freeform.edit.rescan.toolt: Fills the opening again from the same start cell with the blocks as they are now, for example after rebuilding. In a course the leaderboard is archived as with every change.
propwash.race.freeform.edit.intact: Blocks still enclose the opening exactly as when it was placed.
propwash.race.freeform.edit.changed: The opening has changed: %s open spots in the edge, %s cells built over. The stored area still counts – "Rescan" takes the blocks as they are now.
propwash.help.freeform_gate.summary: Gate without a frame: the opening itself counts
propwash.help.freeform_gate.what.1: Hallway, cave mouth or window: the
propwash.help.freeform_gate.what.2: blocks around it form the gate.
propwash.help.freeform_gate.use.1: Right-click the edge of the opening.
propwash.help.freeform_gate.use.3: Shaft: click the inside wall, look down.
propwash.help.freeform_gate.use.4: Course tool: append it, also as start.
gamerule.propwash.freeform_gate_max_size: How large the opening of a freeform gate may be, in blocks per direction: 20 = at most 20 × 20 blocks. Applies when placing and rescanning; placed gates stay as they are. Larger values allow wide halls and caves, smaller ones keep courses tight.
gamerule.propwash.save_assisted_laps.des: On: laps and races flown with a flight aid – altitude or position hold, GPS rescue, changed world rules, creative drone, parts that only fit with “Parts must fit” off, or a goggles latency below the video transmitter's – are saved anyway: the leaderboard, personal best, ghost and race display show them with the badge “Assisted” and the reason. In the leaderboard they get their own section below the unassisted times and never become a record. Off: assisted laps don't count (as before).
propwash.race.assist.other: a flight aid without a stated reason
propwash.race.server.personal_best_assis: Assisted personal best on course %s: %s (place %s assisted, %s) – %s
propwash.race.server.race_best_assisted: Best assisted time over %s laps on course %s: %s – %s
propwash.race.edit.signal.tooltip: When a drone flies through the gate in its flight direction, the block the gate stands on gets a redstone pulse – like from a button. On walls and ceilings it is the block the gate hangs on, for a freeform gate the rim block below the opening. While adjusting, the block is outlined in red.
propwash.race.edit.pulse.tooltip: How long the signal stays on: 2–100 ticks, 20 ticks are 1 second. If the next drone passes before the pulse ends, it starts over. Drag, arrow keys or −/+; right-click: back to 10.
propwash.race.edit.race_only.tooltip: On: only passes during a running race on this gate's course give a signal. The start/finish gate gives one on every pass, because it starts and ends races. Off: every pass, also in free flight.
propwash.race.edit.page.tooltip: Other page of the panel. Sneak + scroll reaches the rows of both pages.
propwash.race.edit.status.signal: Redstone signal changed – press Enter to apply
propwash.help.gate.what.3: A pass sends a redstone signal into the
propwash.help.gate.what.4: block it stands or hangs on.
propwash.help.freeform_gate.use.7: A pass powers the rim block below it.
propwash.race.edit.reset.signal.tooltip: Signal on, 10 ticks, on every pass
propwash.race.edit.signal.target: A pass in flight direction powers the block framed in red: %s.
propwash.race.edit.status.signal_same: No change yet. Scroll or drag to set the signal, Enter applies.
propwash.race.board.edit.tooltip: Name, lap count, gate order, start and finish
propwash.race.course_edit.bind.tooltip: Points your course tool at this course: every gate you click afterwards is added to the end of the course.
propwash.race.course_edit.delete.tooltip: Deletes the course with its leaderboard and ghosts. The gates stay in the world. Click twice.
propwash.race.course_edit.deleted: %s deleted – the gates are still standing
propwash.race.course_edit.denied.no_buil: You can only view %1$s in adventure or spectator mode.
propwash.race.course_edit.denied.not_own: %1$s belongs to %2$s – only its creator or an operator may change the course.
propwash.race.course_edit.denied.other_d: %1$s is in another dimension – you can only change the course there.
propwash.race.course_edit.denied.too_far: %1$s has no creator – you can only change the course close to it (at most %3$s blocks from a gate).
propwash.race.course_edit.denied.world_c: %1$s is a found course – only an operator may delete it.
propwash.race.course_edit.hint.empty: No gate yet – use "Add gates" and click the gates in order.
propwash.race.course_edit.hint.layout: Changing the order, the start or the gates archives the times and ghosts of this layout and begins a new leaderboard. Name and lap count do not affect the rankings.
propwash.race.course_edit.laps.tooltip: A race on this course has this many laps – for every pilot. 0 = endless, free practice with lap times.
propwash.race.course_edit.name: Name
propwash.race.course_edit.name.tooltip: Name of the course, up to 32 characters. Leave empty and the course goes by its number. The name does not affect the rankings.
propwash.race.course_edit.no_tool: You need a course tool in your inventory
propwash.race.course_edit.not_startable: Not possible – start and finish must be a gate or freeform gate
propwash.race.course_edit.remove.tooltip: Take out of the course. The gate stays in the world.
Only a gate or freeform gate can be start and finish.
propwash.race.course_edit.start.tooltip: Move start and finish here – the order stays, counting begins at this gate.
propwash.race.course_edit.title: Edit course
propwash.race.course_edit.tool_bound: Course tool points at %s – click gates to add them
propwash.race.board.empty_archived: No lap time on layout %s yet
